ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 25,000+ reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads use the number, so a buyer scrolling past never sees the reason to trust you. Put 25,000+ reviews on the creative, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 20% off a first order, yet 0 of 20 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put the first order discount in the opening line of three new ads.

5 of 20 copy ads open on “new season favorites”, the single biggest hook, so the account rests on one story. Test two new angles against that opener, one on price and one on a reason to buy this week.
3 “Shop now” ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the outfit in the frame, so the click lands on a store, not the piece they just saw. Point each of the three to its exact product page.
